text.tspan: Router agent. Six components in sequence; route() reads the results of the first five. Every box names its requirements (FR) and design decisions (D).
Five read the draft and give BLOCK. The floor reads classifier confidence and gives ESCALATE.
Source: docs/architecture.md, src/route.py, docs/adr/. Free-tier corroboration: llama3.1-8b + qwen2.5-7b via Ollama, 80/80 on 19 Sep. Counts: run_20260920.
